    (hi : Own A i b) (hj : Own A j c) (hbc : b≠c)
    (f : Grouping) (Q : Finset Axis) (he : i∈Q) (hk : j∈Q) (ha : Allows i A A (stamp (f i))) (hb : Allows j A A (stamp (f j))) (hv : Runs (ν V A) i 1 (stamp (f i))) (hw : Runs (ν W A) j 1 (stamp (f j))) :
